parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The multicloud code. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management hub of threat analysis is deployed. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts within the enterprise.
